name: pvlib-python-interval-semantic-energy-accounting
instr:
pvlib cannot attach explicit temporal meaning to sampled values, so interval workflows can lose boundaries, timezones, labels, or energy. Carry support through interpolation, physical models, arrays, ModelChain, and TMY3 ingestion without changing unsupported workflows.

Make `SupportKind` an Enum. Export `SupportKind`, `TimeSupport`, and `TimeSupportError` from `pvlib` and `pvlib.timesupport`, and `SupportedData` from `pvlib.timesupport`. Keep `calendar_support`, `interpolate_supported`, `infer_time_support`, `total_irradiance_supported`, `cell_temperature_supported`, `ac_energy_supported`, and `read_tmy3_supported` public in their declared `pvlib.clearsky`, `pvlib.iam`, `pvlib.tools`, `pvlib.irradiance`, `pvlib.temperature`, `pvlib.inverter`, and `pvlib.iotools.tmy` modules.

Keep support immutable, timezone-preserving, and unambiguous. Invalid, overlapping, irregularly inferred, incompatible, or durationless conversions must raise `TimeSupportError` deterministically before exposing partial results. `calendar_support(times)` must produce deterministic cyclic monthly intervals across leap years and December-January. `infer_time_support(times, kind=SupportKind.INTERVAL_MEAN)` must derive exact sampling bounds and window membership for regular indexes; irregular indexes require explicit bounds. `interpolate_supported(data, target, method='linear')` must convert at canonical boundaries and conserve accumulated energy. Preserve established unsupported interpolation and sampling
